title: The Compass of Nagasaki's harbor
author: Vesper Lockridge
blurb: August Dravenmoor, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
